registration.kind: Pre-specified, privately frozen component ablation in the logical evaluator (exact metadata vs META8g64, with and without padding exclusion); descriptive; not held-out, not confirmatory, not canonical, not serving, not a deployable policy, not a tuning result

data.split: canonical WikiText-2 test windows (the same 32 windows as the paper's logical evaluation and attempts 008/010)
data.construction: frozen legacy protocol: 32 consecutive non-overlapping windows of 1024 context + 128 scored tokens

registration.selection: All 32 test windows, fixed before scoring, no exclusions and no outcome-dependent selection.

arm_definitions.bf16: Exact K and V native cache
arm_definitions.rabit: Frozen policy: K3 with zero-padded open group, V2, META8g64, R4 (canonical)
arm_definitions.range_real: Padding-only control: K3 excludes artificial padding zeros of the incomplete group (repeat-last padding for extrema); V2, META8g64, R4 unchanged
arm_definitions.meta_exact: Frozen policy except that K and V codes are dequantized with the exact FP32 primary minima and scales (no META8 second-level quantization)
arm_definitions.range_meta_exact: Padding exclusion as in range_real, plus exact FP32 primary minima and scales as in meta_exact

registration.controls: Window 1: pass-through equals bf16 and each oracle replay (independent kvquant_k3 reference, with the same padding and metadata variants) equals its arm, bitwise; same-device oracle checkpoints for every quantized arm
registration.reproduction_check: bf16, rabit and range_real on all 32 windows must equal attempt 008 per-token NLL bit for bit (baseline008/); otherwise the run is INVALID
registration.execution: single H100 80GB HBM3 Pod, scientific retries zero; no rerun without a new author approval; every attempt is reported

analysis.script: a001_analysis.py (frozen; sha256 in the freeze record)
analysis.decision_rule: none: descriptive ablation; no arm adopted; the paper's operating point is unchanged
analysis.reporting: every arm and model reported whatever the direction; invalid run reported as INVALID with no quality conclusion

interpretation_limits: logical evaluator only; serving engine unchanged and not scored
fixed FLASH_ATTENTION backend, not the canonical automatic-backend configuration; not comparable with the paper's Table 3
range_real and the exact-metadata arms exist only in the logical evaluator; no physical layout, kernel, capacity, latency or throughput is implied
exact-metadata arms use FP32 primaries; the storage counterpart is arithmetic only (3.56x vs BF16 for FP32 metadata)
paired contrasts are not additive decompositions
test windows are not held out
